Lending to YHWH

“Whoever is kind to the poor lends to YHWH, and he will repay him for his deed.” Your support through prayer, emails and encouragement is a blessing. You can also support the association financially, materially, or with your time.

Other ways to give

Pray

Carry the association and the people we serve in prayer, and join our prayer evenings.

Write

A letter of encouragement, delivered by the team to someone who needs it.

Give your time

Food drives, outreach, workshops, translation, photography: every talent counts.

Give in kind

Warm clothing, school supplies, non-perishable food: write to us before dropping off.

A Christian association serving orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless — Montréal, since 2014.
